title: Grateful Dead Live at Manor Downs on 1985-08-31
lineage: Master AUD Cassettes > Nakamichi Cassette Deck 2 (azimuth adjusted) > Kind Kables RCA/XLR > Lunatec V3(@24/96)* > coax > M-Audio Audiophile 2496 > WaveLab 5.0 > WAV > Traders Little Helper > FLAC24  *V3 recording levels set equally at 25 + 3 trim
source: (FOB) 2 Sennheiser 441s > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX 90s  FOB, 10-15 rows back, DFC

ai_review.summary: Loud, clear 3‑D audience stereo capture of a terrific 1985 Dead show, though the channels are slightly out of phase.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this 1985 audience recording, praising its loud and crystal‑clear three‑dimensional sound that brings the venue’s energy to life. The performance itself is described as great with lasting memories, but one technical note mentions the left/right channels being out of phase, which can be corrected for optimal listening.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings and enthusiastic comments indicate a strong musical performance; recording is praised for clarity despite a minor phase issue, supporting an overall rating in the upper‑mid range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Loud, clear, 3‑D stereo sound praised by multiple reviewers; however, channels are out of phase and require inversion for best playback.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers emphasize the overall energy and venue atmosphere, calling the show terrific without noting specific set‑list issues.
